verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: 5G mobile networks do not transmit or accelerate the spread of COVID-19. The virus spreads via respiratory droplets and has actively spread in areas with no 5G networks.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple international public health organizations, scientific bodies, and fact-checking outlets have confirmed that 5G mobile networks do not transmit or accelerate the spread of COVID-19. The virus spreads through respiratory droplets, not radio waves, and has spread in regions without 5G networks.
